email_body:
Hello Leed careers team,

I'm applying for your Graduate Civil Engineer Program. I saw the December 2026 expression of interest and your recent post saying you are still looking for graduates for regional projects in Victoria and NSW, including Snowy 2.0.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I'm based in Melton VIC with a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I'm available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your page says you want graduates who want to be on site, not just in an office, and that is the work I'm after, on roads, earthworks and pipelines. My site experience so far is overseas, so I would start at graduate level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we talk about a place in the program?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

paragraphs: I am applying for Leed's Graduate Civil Engineer Program. Your recent post said you are still looking for graduates for regional projects in Victoria and NSW, including Snowy 2.0, and that the roles suit people interested in FIFO and DIDO work. That is the kind of start I want.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia. There I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD to Australian Standards, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings and carried out inspections and quality checks. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, wrote site and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

I am based in Melton VIC with an Australian driver's licence, my own transport and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work. My site experience so far is overseas, so I would start at graduate level and value the mentoring your program offers.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the program.
